intro: In Stormwind, Brother Joshua guides those who come to the Cathedral of Light to learn the ways of the Holy Light. He trains novice priests to heal wounds and strengthen their allies.

p: Brother Joshua waits near the main altar in Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, ready to teach new servants of the faith. A priest of the Church of the Holy Light, he instructs them in healing, protective wards, and the focus needed to commune with the Light. Young human priests beginning their service to the Alliance find one of their first guides in him.
